status: pre-specified; written before any data for this study exists

definitions.complete_pair: a (task, scorer) triple contributes a paired difference for contrast A-B iff both A and B yielded a score for that task and scorer
definitions.cell_mean: unweighted mean of paired differences over tasks in that dataset with a complete pair for that scorer
definitions.task_level_effect: mean of a task's paired differences across the scorers with a complete pair (1-4 values)

primary_analysis.population: the 500 fully held-out tasks (250 Arena-Hard + 250 WildBench); no prior use in any phase
primary_analysis.population_rationale: MT-Bench is excluded from the primary because 74 of its 78 tasks carry prior exposure
primary_analysis.sign_convention: positive means the injected low personal history reduced the scorer's current judgement

estimator.method: equal-weight mean of the 8 (dataset x scorer) cell means

key_secondary_analysis.label: complete 578-task result

estimator.method: equal-weight mean of the 12 (dataset x scorer) cell means

key_secondary_analysis.caveat: places 1/3 of the dataset weight on MT-Bench, which is 95% previously used

bootstrap.cluster: all scorer x condition records of a task travel together; a task drawn twice contributes its records twice
bootstrap.stratification: by dataset; within each stratum draw with replacement the same number of tasks the stratum contains
bootstrap.shared_draws: one resampled task-set per replicate feeds every statistic in this plan

empty_cell_rule.action: average over the non-empty cells in that replicate
empty_cell_rule.report: count of replicates with any empty cell

secondary_summaries.name: task_weighted_pooled
secondary_summaries.definition: unweighted mean over tasks of the task-level effect; each task equal weight, scorers averaged within task first

secondary_summaries.name: pair_weighted_pooled
secondary_summaries.definition: unweighted mean over all complete (task, scorer) pairs
secondary_summaries.note: the only direct numerical comparator to the 90-task adjudicated 1.201

secondary_summaries.name: dataset_wise
secondary_summaries.definition: per dataset, mean of its 4 scorer cell means

secondary_summaries.name: scorer_wise
secondary_summaries.definition: per scorer, mean of its dataset cell means

secondary_summaries.name: per_condition_levels
secondary_summaries.definition: mean, SD, N per condition x scorer x dataset (descriptive)

task_level_distribution.denominator: tasks with at least one complete pair (N stated)

rules: recover only an explicitly stated score: a score-meaning label in any language, or an explicit verdict verb, adjacent to an explicit /10 or 'out of 10'
never a number lifted from the rationale
never a component or criterion score presented as the verdict
ambiguous responses remain unresolved and stay excluded from every analysis

blinded_review.ordering: adjudication completes before any contrast is computed

independent_verification.method: a second independent blinded pass re-derives the score from the response text without seeing the first pass's value
independent_verification.on_disagreement: leave the response unresolved; never split the difference, never prefer one reader

measurement_and_adjudication.evidence_required_per_recovery: the quoted phrase that justifies the score
measurement_and_adjudication.freezing: adjudication file written, hashed, and frozen before analysis; hash recorded in the results manifest

attrition_reporting.note: described and interpreted in the write-up; does NOT alter which analysis is primary

diagnostic_contrasts.caveat: with 7 contrasts across several scopes some will exclude zero by chance; not seven independent confirmations

R1_trimmed_mean.applied: within each cell, in place of the mean

report: 10 most influential tasks by absolute shift

R4_prior_use_descriptive.confound_statement: Previous-use status is completely confounded with MT-Bench and cannot receive a causal interpretation. All 74 previously-used tasks are MT-Bench; only 4 MT-Bench tasks are naive, so any group difference is indistinguishable from a MT-Bench vs other-datasets difference.
R4_prior_use_descriptive.forbidden_claim: no statement of the form 'prior exposure changes the effect' may be made from this comparison
R4_prior_use_descriptive.design_level_answer: the primary analysis, restricted to the 500 never-used tasks

collection_failure_policy.determinism_note: with do_sample=False and a fixed seed a deterministic empty output reproduces on retry; retries absorb environmental faults (CUDA/OOM/transient IO), not model behaviour

implementation_change_required.change: disable reserve substitution on persistent failure
implementation_change_required.reason: current code substitutes from the reserve list; the plan forbids it

collection_failure_policy.exclusion_on_answer_quality_scores_or_ef: never, at any point, for any reason

open_decisions.issue: Mistral's official chat template injects a default system persona AND today's date via strftime_now when no system turn is supplied, so 'use the official template' and 'add no system prompt' cannot both be satisfied as written
open_decisions.verified: by reading the template at the pinned revision
consequences: a user-only message does not yield a system-prompt-free prompt for this model (Qwen verified clean by contrast)
the rendered prompt changes every calendar day, so scoring prompts are not byte-reproducible
the default persona tells the model to ask for clarification rather than answer ambiguous requests, plausibly raising non-score responses for this scorer specifically
options: pass an explicit empty system message
accept the default persona and pin the date
modify the template to skip the system block
open_decisions.recommendation: pass an explicit empty system message: no persona, no evaluation instructions, no date leakage, template unmodified; cost is an empty [SYSTEM_PROMPT][/SYSTEM_PROMPT] tag pair
open_decisions.related_action: the pre-flight gate should record the RENDERED template output for one fixed task per scorer, not just the template hash, because Llama-3.1's template is known in some versions to inject a 'Today Date:' string and could not be re-verified from here (gated repo)

open_decisions.issue: the 24B scorer does not fit on the current GPU in BF16 and quantization is excluded
open_decisions.implementation_note: exact_generation pins device_map={"": 0}, which forces one device and will OOM; a 24B scorer needs device_map="auto" or a larger single card

open_decisions.issue: Mistral ships generation_config with temperature 0.15 and do_sample true
open_decisions.status: mitigated: do_sample=False is passed explicitly on every call, overriding the shipped default; expect a benign 'temperature set while do_sample=False' warning

open_decisions.issue: confirm the 10% symmetric trim is applied within each cell rather than to the set of cell means
bootstrap empty-cell rule needs sign-off even though it should never fire
open_decisions.recommendation: average over non-empty cells and report the affected replicate count

open_decisions.issue: independent verification of manually recovered scores requires a genuinely separate second reader
open_decisions.recommendation: confirm who performs the second blinded pass, and that it does not see the first pass's value; otherwise the requirement is nominal rather than real
